page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. In the right margin, beside the fourth line of the first paragraph, one marginal reference of two lines. Below the first paragraph, the section numbers LX. and LXI. each stand centred on their own line, then a paragraph follows. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: illa nubes est, ex qua siccus ille halitus elicitur: tonitrui non amplius ista, sed illa quæ icta est: quia sonitus ille quicquid Vulgus dicat, de sententia Philosophi, non elisione fit, sed ictu, cum elisus ille halitus sive Spiritus in aliamLib.2.Me-teor.cap.8 nubem densam incidit: quo ictu tum sonus editur, tum Spiritus accenditur: quæ accensio tonitrui consectarium quoddam est.
Maris denique & salsæ illius aquæ subiectum concretum corpus est, quod è potiore parte elementi aquæ, & sicco illo, qui unâ cum pluvia deorsum perpetuo fertur, halitu, constat.

Concludimus ergo, primum & adæquatum Meteoro-logicarum affectionum subiectum imperfecte mixtum corpus, quâ tale est, esse, idque ex uno è quatuor elementis & alterutro halitu concretum corpus esse: quod quatuor præcipuas sub se species comprehendit, concretionem è sicco illo halitu & elemento ignis, ex aere & alterutro ha-litu, è terra & alterutro halitu, ex aqua & halitu sicco,

page.notes: The first word of the page is a long initial, read as "illa" (it may be "Illa" in capitals). The page number at the head is a small ornamented mark, read as 9 [?]. The section numbers LX. and LXI. are set as centred bare numerals and are therefore given as paragraphs, not headings. The margin reference reads "Lib.2.Meteor. cap.8" with the final numeral uncertain. Woodcut ornament at the lower centre is not text and is omitted.
